sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Three of the five incidents this quarter came from config changes.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Config changes don't go through review at all.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: From next sprint, every config change needs a second reviewer.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Good.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Agreed.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Nobody reviews config changes.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: And config changes caused three of our five incidents.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: So starting next sprint, config changes need a second reviewer like code does.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Yes.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: The incident response was slow at the start.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: It took forty minutes before anyone realised it was a real outage.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Because the alert went to an old channel.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We move all paging alerts to the on-call channel and test them monthly.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Should've done that ages ago.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: The alert went to a channel nobody watches anymore.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: So we only noticed the outage after forty minutes.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: All paging goes to the on-call channel, with a monthly test.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Good.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Standups have been running long.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: They turn into problem-solving sessions.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We cap standup at fifteen minutes and take discussions offline.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Thank you.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Standup keeps becoming a design discussion.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: It's often thirty minutes now.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Hard limit of fifteen minutes, and anything deeper happens afterwards.
